metadata.comment: Export of the pag0 reconstruction. Voxel-aligned with 20250728140407 - identity transform, established by 3D cross-correlation of full-resolution blocks at three locations including one ~2300 px off the rotation axis, where the disabled detector distortion correction would have shown. The export's metadata.json reported target_window_f32 -0.03/0.145, the paganin1000 default that its workflow records regardless of the window actually applied; window_u16 0..65535 means the full range of this reconstruction's own 32-bit conversion was written, so the f32 window recorded here is derived from that conversion instead. Masking is unreliable at both z ends: an unmasked blob over z 1144-1310, and the full reconstruction disc including the sample holder from z 20448 to the end of the array.

Export of the pag50 reconstruction. Voxel-aligned with 20250728140407 - identity transform, established by 3D cross-correlation of full-resolution blocks; it agrees with its pag0 sibling 20251107132835 to r=0.98 at zero shift. The export's metadata.json reported target_window_f32 -0.03/0.145, the paganin1000 default that its workflow records regardless of the window actually applied; window_u16 0..65535 means the full range of this reconstruction's own 32-bit conversion was written, so the f32 window recorded here is derived from that conversion instead. Masking is unreliable at both z ends, in the same places as 20251107132835: an unmasked blob over z 1144-1310, and the full reconstruction disc including the sample holder from z 20448 to the end.
